results.title: Netlify is rated "Poor" with 2 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Looking at 44 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. People frequently encountered unexpected financial charges and frustrating ongoing issues with the credit system, which often led to websites being completely locked down without warning. Customers also mentioned that customer support was extremely unresponsive, unhelpful, and difficult to reach when they tried to re solve these urgent account problems. Some reviewers were happy with the platform, noting that it provides great features and tools for starting small projects and simple websites. Other users appreciated the deployment flexibility, stating that it offers an efficient and seamless process once everything is properly set up.See more [...] Their credit system can be nebulous and frustrating, but if you understand the utilization and get the right plan, it's a predictable expense.
